note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 at HEAD 635aa08b78 (independent judge, clean clone). Section 4.4.1: "Since the SPD-I is just a part of the SPD, if a packet that is looked up in the SPD-I cannot be matched to an entry there, then the packet MUST be discarded." dc7de8e76f and 000e6fdfea changed the two cited units releaseSPD and warnSPDLeft, and nothing else this verdict cites. releaseSPD's only change is the call warnSPDLeft(log) becoming warnSPDLeft(dp, log). warnSPDLeft now names each leftover through spdLeft.describe(dp), which copies the ledger out under l.mu and asks policyDeleteCommand (inner_selectors.go) for each entry's removal command: dataplane.XFRMPolicyDeleteCommand for xfrmBackend, the recorded spdEntries entry for vppBackend (vppPolicyDelCommand), and a plain text naming the selector when the backend names none or a nil dataplane is passed. policyDeleteCommand always returns a string, so describe still returns exactly one name per ledger entry, and warnSPDLeft still returns true exactly when the ledger holds an entry: the decision to keep the catch-all is unchanged, only the text of the warning is. Probe in the clone (go -overlay, tree untouched): warnSPDLeft made to return false always, and describe made to return no name, each turn TestReleaseSPDKeepsTheCatchAllWhenARemovalFails, TestChildInstallRollbackFailureIsRecordedInTheSPDLedger, TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheExactRemovalCommand and TestSPDLeftoverNamesTheBackendCommand red. The gap paths are unchanged: vppPolicyInterface is byte-identical, so VPP still runs only under `unmatched bypass` with no catch-all (CatchAllSupported answering ErrNoNodeWideSPD), and defaultDataplaneSource is byte-identical, so the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries still have no catch-all beneath them; an inbound packet on either path can meet no SPD-I entry and be delivered. dc7de8e76f's VPP change (a stranded retry deletes the SPD entry the backend recorded) removes Child SA entries and installs none, so it adds no final entry. Gap stands; {gap} annotation accurate.
